content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a small application involving a KNX system. The setup includes one KNX button connected to a [product_name] via the [product_name] communication module. I want to connect the [product_name] communication module to [version_no] without using [product_name]. Is this possible? Thanks for your time. [document]

No, this isn't possible. The [product_name] communication module only works with [product_name] modules from the [article_no] series. It also doesn't function with [product_name] modules from [article_no].

Hello [user_name], This solution may be too costly if you're only managing a single KNX button, but for larger projects, you might find this resource helpful: Communication with [version_no] and KNX ([url]). The [document] provides access to a [version_no] project for a Profinet-KNX gateway integration. Hope this helps, [user_name]

Thank you for sharing that information. I tried searching for [article_no] [product_name] modules for my project at [url], but only [article_no] is available. I'm unsure whether this [product_name] module supports KNX systems. Could you provide some guidance?
Yes, this [product_name] module supports communication with the [product_name] communication module. It's the current [product_name] version [version_no]. [product_name] Basic Modules

analysis.insight_summary: Users are attempting to connect a KNX button to their control system using [company_name] modules, but are hitting compatibility issues. The main challenge is that the [product_name] communication module cannot interface directly with [version_no] controllers, as it only supports specific [product_name] module series. Additionally, users struggle to find suitable modules in the product catalog for KNX integration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] communication module to work directly with [version_no] controllers, or to easily find compatible [product_name] modules to integrate KNX systems.
